verdict: The M1790 source package has sound frozen identities, public-port-only stimulus, an independent 10x10 signed-INT8 plus Q24-bias/threshold result reference, a strict DUT-only SAIF parser, exact annotation and zero-black-box/zero-macro PTPX gates, and one-shot execution governance. It is not launchable yet. The testbench claims tile_done_tag checking but only checks X/Z and count, and the one-shot runner does not semantically bind the future M1792 release to the exact runner, source contract, M1791 review, claim boundary, and double seal. No EDA campaign is authorized until an additive successor fixes both P1 findings and receives a fresh different-author review.

testbench: No force, private DUT hierarchy, deposit, VPI backdoor, initreg, timing suppression, or prior simulator reuse is present.
The scoreboard independently computes all 10x10 signed-INT8 products, Q24 biases, saturation, threshold decisions, result tags, result beats, valid bits, data, and context-retire latency.

A 3.000 ns clock, one warmup tile outside SAIF, eight dense measured tiles, legal result backpressure, natural raw backpressure, public X/Z fatal gates, protocol_error fatal gate, and watchdogs are present.
saif_ptpx: The UCLI sequence records only tb_m1790_c3_m1454_fixed_t10_mapped_energy.dut between two explicit stops.
The parser requires DURATION == measurement_cycles*3 ns, equal T0/T1/TX/TC/IG cardinality, TX==0, activity conservation, and nonzero toggles.

PrimeTime PX requires zero black boxes, zero memory macros, TT 0.9 V 25 C, ideal clock, ZeroWireload, no SPEF, 100% nets, 100% leaf cells, check_power success, unique power fields, and component-power conservation.
one_shot: The proposed budget is exactly one fresh VCS compile, one mapped simulation, one checked SAIF, and one PTPX run.
Attempt consumption, no retry, no artifact reuse, same-UID collision exclusion, shared queue serialization, resource gates, and atomic no-replace publication are present.

findings.title: tile_done_tag is claimed but not checked against the expected tile sequence
findings.evidence: tb_m1790...sv lines 279-283 only reject X/Z and increment tile_done_count. No expected tile-done tag queue or comparison exists. The M1790 author receipt nevertheless lists tile_done_tag among checked public fields.
findings.risk: A mapped implementation could emit the correct five result beats but a stale or wrong tile_done_tag and still produce the sole PASS token.
findings.required_fix: Add a separate expected tile-done tag queue/index, compare every sampled_tile_done_tag in order, fail on extra/missing/wrong tags, print a machine-checked tile-done summary, and add a mutation that removes or corrupts this comparison.

findings.title: The future release is externally pinned but not semantically bound or double-seal checked
findings.evidence: run_m1790...one_shot.py lines 163-174 checks the supplied M1792 file SHA, status, and budget only. It does not require release identity fields equal to sha(RUNNER), sha(CONTRACT), and sha(M1791/review.json), does not require the all-false prelaunch claim boundary, and does not verify M1792 .sha256 and .sha256.seal.sha256 even though the source contract records double_seal=true.
findings.risk: A same-status/same-budget release copied from a different successor identity could be externally pinned and accepted, defeating exact source-to-review-to-release transitivity.
findings.required_fix: Make the runner require an exact release schema, identity object bound to the current runner/contract/M1791 review hashes, exact all-false prelaunch claim boundary, exact one-shot budget, and valid release sidecar plus outer seal. Add independent mutations for every binding.

m1792_collision_disposition.historical_conflict: A separate C2 successor temporarily occupied M1792 during review startup.
m1792_collision_disposition.close_state: The C2 successor files/contracts were re-homed and the old rtl_m1792/tb_m1792/filelist/checker identities were removed. M1792 is therefore available for the future C3 release.

required_next_gate: Create an additive corrected M1790 source successor without modifying this review or predecessor evidence, then obtain a fresh different-author hammer with P0=0 and P1=0 before creating any M1792 release or launching EDA.
